headline: Oil Prices Rebound Following Midterm Election Volatility
summary: Oil prices recovered after sliding more than 8% in the previous session, which followed the Democratic party's sweep in the midterm elections.
why: Energy prices are highly sensitive to political shifts that may impact environmental regulation, trade policy, and domestic production incentives.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Market correction following a sharp decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Markets often experience volatility following major political shifts as investors reprice assets based on expected changes in energy policy and fiscal outlooks.
